Coffee Fun
Well I'm sitting here, bored as hell, and I think to myself, 'I wonder if I could get a kickass boost off of snorting coffee?'  I decide to try it by filling a pen-cap with grounds of 100% Arabica ( BTW, the darker the grounds, the better the rush.)  After doing this I carefully put the small end up my nose and take a big snort.  I wait two minutes and I can feel a strong rush, almost feels like I just became Superman.
It's kind of weird at first but it begins to feel better after doing it a couple more times.
